result.instructions: Tools for Agendor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are still open in my main sales funnel, and what stage is each one in?"; "Find the person named Ana Souza and show her organization and open tasks."; "Move the deal 'Website redesign' to the proposal stage.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Agendor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agendor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agendor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agendor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. agendor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agendor_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: Return the Agendor user that owns the API token (name, email, role, active flag). Good first call to check the connection. Agendor API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: agendor_list_funnels
tools.title: List sales funnels
tools.description: List the sales funnels (pipelines) in the account. Use the funnel id with the stage tools. Agendor API: GET /funnels.

tools.name: agendor_list_deal_stages
tools.title: List deal stages
tools.description: List the stages of a sales funnel, with their sequence numbers. Use the sequence number as dealStage in the stage tools (it is not the stage id). Agendor API: GET /deal_stages.

funnel.description: The funnel (omit for the default funnel) id.

tools.name: agendor_list_loss_reasons
tools.title: List loss reasons
tools.description: List the reasons that can close a deal as lost. Use the id with agendor_set_deal_status. Agendor API: GET /loss_reasons.

tools.name: agendor_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products in the catalogue, paginated. Agendor API: GET /products.

tools.name: agendor_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: Search and list people (contacts) with filters by name, email, organization, owner or last update date. Paginated. Agendor API: GET /people.

organization.description: The organization (filter people of one organization) id.

userOwner.description: The owner user (filter by the user who owns the person) id.

updatedAtGt.description: Only people updated after this time, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: agendor_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Get one person by id, with contact details and organization. Agendor API: GET /people/{id}.

person_id.description: The person id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: agendor_create_person
tools.title: Create a person
tools.description: Create a person (contact). Only name is required. Creates a record that stays in the account. Agendor API: POST /people.

organization.description: The organization to link the person to id.

contact.description: Contact details: email, work phone and mobile phone.

tools.name: agendor_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: Update fields of one person. Send only the fields to change. Repeating the same update gives the same result. Agendor API: PUT /people/{id}.

person_id.description: The person id (from the matching list tool).

organization.description: The organization to link the person to id.

contact.description: Contact details: email, work phone and mobile phone.

tools.name: agendor_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: Search and list organizations (companies) by name, CNPJ, email, owner or last update date. Paginated. Agendor API: GET /organizations.

cnpj.description: Filter by CNPJ (Brazilian company tax id).

updatedAtGt.description: Only organizations updated after this time, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: agendor_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Get one organization by id, with contact details and address. Agendor API: GET /organizations/{id}.

organization_id.description: The organization id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: agendor_create_organization
tools.title: Create an organization
tools.description: Create an organization (company). Only name is required. Creates a record that stays in the account. Agendor API: POST /organizations.

cnpj.description: Brazilian CNPJ (company tax id), digits only.

contact.description: Contact details: email, work phone and mobile phone.

tools.name: agendor_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: Search and list deals (sales opportunities) by title, status, stage, owner, linked person or organization, or update date. Paginated. Agendor API: GET /deals.

dealStatus.description: Deal status code: 1, 2 or 3 (the API docs list no labels).

dealStage.description: Stage sequence number (not the stage id).

organization.description: The organization linked to the deal id.

person.description: The person linked to the deal id.

updatedAtGt.description: Only deals updated after this time, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: agendor_get_deal
tools.title: Get a deal
tools.description: Get one deal by id: title, value, status, stage, owner and linked people or organization. Agendor API: GET /deals/{id}.

deal_id.description: The deal id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: agendor_create_deal_for_person
tools.title: Create a deal for a person
tools.description: Create a deal linked to one person. Only title and the person id are required. Creates a record that stays in the account. Agendor API: POST /people/{person_id}/deals.

person_id.description: The person the deal belongs to id (from the matching list tool).

funnel.description: The funnel (omit for the default funnel) id.

dealStage.description: Stage sequence number in the funnel (not the stage id).

annotations.title: Create a deal for a person

tools.name: agendor_move_deal_stage
tools.title: Move a deal to another stage
tools.description: Move one deal to a stage of its funnel. dealStage is the stage sequence number from agendor_list_deal_stages. Repeating the same move gives the same result. Agendor API: PUT /deals/{id}/stage.

deal_id.description: The deal id (from the matching list tool).

dealStage.description: Stage sequence number, starting at 1 for the first stage.

funnel.description: The funnel of the target stage (required when it is not the default funnel) id.

annotations.title: Move a deal to another stage

tools.name: agendor_set_deal_status
tools.title: Set a deal status
tools.description: Set one deal to ongoing, won or lost. For lost, pass lossReason with an id from agendor_list_loss_reasons. Repeating the same status gives the same result. Agendor API: PUT /deals/{id}/status.

deal_id.description: The deal id (from the matching list tool).

lossReason.description: Loss reason. Use only when dealStatusText is lost.

description.description: Specific note on why the deal was lost.

tools.name: agendor_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (follow-ups, calls, meetings) with filters by linked entity, completion and due date. Paginated. Agendor API: GET /tasks.

entityId.description: The linked record (use with entityType) id.

finishedEq.description: true for finished tasks, false for open tasks.

dueDateGt.description: Only tasks due after this time, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

dueDateLt.description: Only tasks due before this time, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: agendor_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account (id, name, email, active flag). Use the id as an owner filter in the list tools. Agendor API: GET /users.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.description: What you can do with Agendor here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_open_deals_of_a_funnel
prompts.title: Review the open deals of a funnel
prompts.description: List the funnels and their deal stages. Then list deals by stage, owner or status.

prompts.name: find_a_person_and_the_deals_linked_to_them
prompts.title: Find a person and the deals linked to them
prompts.description: Search people by name or email. Open one to read its organization, then list the deals linked to that person.

prompts.name: review_an_organization_and_its_tasks
prompts.title: Review an organization and its tasks
prompts.description: Search organizations by name or CNPJ. Open one, then list the tasks linked to it.

prompts.name: add_a_new_person_and_organization
prompts.title: Add a new person and organization
prompts.description: Create an organization, then create a person. Only the name is required for each record.

prompts.name: open_a_deal_and_move_it_through_the_funnel
prompts.title: Open a deal and move it through the funnel
prompts.description: Create a deal linked to a person. Then move it to another stage of its funnel.

prompts.name: close_a_deal_as_won_or_lost
prompts.title: Close a deal as won or lost
prompts.description: Set a deal to won, or to lost with a reason. List the loss reasons to find the reason id.
